environment: Isolated local PostgreSQL 17.6 on loopback; not live Supabase
checks: SQL Editor preflight rejects incompatible schema before mutations and the outer transaction rolls back
SQL Editor bundle applies all hotfixes and seven migrations together; every migration applies again without errors
Malformed replacement rolls back cloud metadata, cloud tracks and shared publication
Same titles retain distinct identities; cross-device rename and retry reuse one cloud/shared identity
Hide/delete affects only the selected stable identity, preserving another playlist with the same title
Direct REST mutations and legacy column grants are blocked; only owner-checked transaction RPCs can write playlists
Anonymous cannot read hidden activity, follow graph, playlists or child tracks, nor delete accounts
Owner can read own private data; second user cannot replace another owner's playlist
Explicit additions, deletions and re-additions are owner scoped; invalid batch rolls back every edit
Atomic ordered snapshots preserve 1,025 tracks in one JSON value and cannot bypass private-playlist RLS
Queue replacement failure preserves previous queue
Playlist deletion removes owner cloud/shared data together, rejects numeric clients and stale-device resurrection
Account deletion removes only authenticated account and its cloud state, preserving other account
